title: Arithmetic probability measures
summary: We consider probability measures on compact subsets of the complex plane arising as limiting distributions of Galois conjugates of certain algebraic integers. These measures are characterized by infinitely many integral inequalities, one for each nonzero integer polynomial. We study a broad family of measures given by particular convex combinations of harmonic and equilibrium measures. We then show that, for measures in this family, it suffices to verify two conditions to guarantee all the required inequalities.
